source_messages.content: You are auditing access authorization for a deliberately scoped AWS IAM scenario. Only identity-based policies, an optional permissions boundary, and an optional SCP apply. No resource policies, cross-account access, sessions, RCPs, or other restrictions exist. Use default implicit deny; any applicable explicit Deny wins. Identity-based Allow is required, and if a permissions boundary or SCP is provided each must also Allow. Match Action case-insensitively, Resource case-sensitively, with only * and ? wildcards. StringEquals matches values literally and case-sensitively; context key names are case-insensitive. Context values are single strings. A missing condition key does not match. Return ONLY a JSON object with exactly two keys: decision (ALLOW or DENY) and reason (a short, nonempty explanation).
